question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Observe
solution:
The correct answer is "**Watch**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **"Observe" means to watch carefully or attentively**.(निरीक्षण)

 
 
• Example: He observed the behavior of the animals in the zoo.
 
 
 
• **"Watch" means to look at somebody/something for a time, paying attention to what happens.** (ध्यान से देखना)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option is Watch because it means the same as Observe.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ignore means to pay no attention to something or someone.(अनदेखा करना)
 
• Deserve means to be worthy of something, usually as a result of one's actions or qualities.(योग्य होना)
 
• Clarify means to make something clear or easier to understand. (स्पष्ट करना)
